findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: request_blind_counter_quotes · Private data: calculate_managed_gcp_ai · Public sink: request_blind_counter_quotes · Destructive: calculate_managed_gcp_ai.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: request_blind_counter_quotes · Private data: calculate_managed_gcp_ai · Public sink: request_blind_counter_quotes · Destructive: calculate_managed_gcp_ai

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
